result.topic_en: Riemann expands z(x+h+k) in two ways, as a double series in powers of h and k and as a single series in powers of (h+k), compares them, and derives the composition law for generalized derivatives together with the functional equation c_{μ+ν}=c_μ c_ν for the coefficient function c, which he extends to rational and then all values.
